resample_timeseries: resample a pandas Series against axes frequency for time-series plotting with automatic upsampling
convert_datetime_index: convert a DatetimeIndex to ordinal-integer index for evenly-spaced matplotlib time-series plotting
prepare_timeseries_data: prepare a pandas Series for time-series plotting by resampling and decorating axes with frequency info
format_dateaxis_ticks: format the x-axis of a matplotlib subplot with dynamic tick locators and date formatters for time-series data
check_dynamic_xaxis: check whether a time-series index should use dynamic x-axis mode based on frequency and existing plot state
